caption: The drawing depicts a single earthenware jug or pitcher placed against a plain, light beige background. The jug is predominantly brown with variations in shade, including areas of darker and lighter brown, hints of orange, yellow, and greenish hues, creating a mottled and textured appearance. The jug has a rounded, bulbous body that narrows at the top, a prominent spout for pouring on one side, and a sturdy handle attached to the opposite side. The jug features a raised, decorative band with a twisted rope-like pattern encircling the upper part of its body, just below the rim. The base of the jug is slightly raised and its surface appears smooth, with the light source creating subtle highlights and shadows that suggest a reflective, glazed finish. There are no additional objects or decorations in the drawing.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
